title: Hillenkoetter frustrated at being kept in the dark about Roswell

tellings.quote: it's so interesting because I think he was frustrated at not getting the proper information about Roswell.

plain: Roscoe Hillenkoetter, an early director of the CIA, was frustrated that he was never properly told what happened at Roswell, the 1947 incident in New Mexico where some say a crashed craft was recovered. That is Michels's own reading, which he offers while talking about Hillenkoetter alongside Donald Keyhoe, a writer on UFOs. If true, it would mean that even the head of the CIA was kept outside the circle that knew about Roswell.
